sources.title: AI-based constitutive model simulator for predicting the axial load ...
sources.snippet: In the second phase, a machine learning-based model was used to predict the axial load-deflection of columns. A dataset containing 196 experimental results from an original study was compiled, including eight key input parameters selected for their relevance to predicting structural deflection under axial loads.
